name: All Signs Options Free
author: Vertim Coders

sections.description:
About the All Signs Options Free

  • Plugin site: signsdesigner.us

Overview

The ultimate app for selling custom signs with WooCommerce.
Supports a wide range of products such as acrylic signs, metal signs, Aluminium signs, Doors Signs, Plastic Signs, etc.

Features

  • Custom TTF fonts support
  • Custom colors palette for limited colors usage
  • Definition of customization sizes and number of characters per text
  • Translation ready
  • Shortcode available
  • Design data in cart
  • Pricing calculation
  • Automatic calculation of text height
  • Responsive and user-friendly

Pro features

  • More Size
  • More Colors
  • Material Advance
  • Material Advance
  • More Configurations
  • Templates designs
  • Upload Image on configurator
  • Output svg and pdf file
  • Additonnal Component on Material
  • Additonnal Options on configurator

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • Woocommerce version 7.4 or greater
  • PHP version 7.0 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater

This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working

Automatic installation (easiest way)

To do an automatic install of All Signs Options Free, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New.

In the search field type “All Signs Options Free” and click Search Plugins. Once you have found it you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”.

Manual installation

Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  1. Download `all-signs-options-free.zip`
  2. Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  3. Navigate to the ‘Upload’ area
  4. Select `all-signs-options-free.zip` from your computer
  5. Click ‘Install Now’
  6. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

Using FTP

  1. Download `all-signs-options-free.zip`
  2. Extract the `all-signs-options-free` directory to your computer
  3. Upload the `all-signs-options-free` directory to the `/wp-content/plugins/` directory
  4. Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to install a WordPress plugin.

Updating

You can use automatic update to update the plugin safely.
